title: 第23章 服丹虫灾算计第24章 画圈过年巫教
content_zh:
酒足饭饱，杯盘狼藉。
路沉回到羊粪胡同那处小院。
入夜，路沉吞下那枚梅花丹。
药力化开，初时只觉一股暖流自腹中升起，缓缓蔓延四肢。
他裹紧被子躺在炕上，闭目调息。
没过多久，那暖意忽地一滞，随即化作阵阵诡异的麻痒，仿佛有无数细虫在血脉里钻爬。
路沉额角渗出冷汗。
就在这时，耳边响起呢喃。
起初是模糊的杂音，渐渐变得清晰。
却是一种他完全听不懂的、黏稠扭曲的低语。
那声音越来越近，越来越响，最后竟贴着他耳膜，一字一字挤出他能听懂的话
“娘……娘……”
“剖开肚子……放我出去……”
凄厉的童音，带着哭腔，却字字冰冷，像从他自己肚子里爬出来。
路沉猛地睁眼，一把抓起炕头的白酒，咬开塞子就往喉咙里灌。
烈酒灼喉而下。
腹中陡然传来一声尖厉的、非人的惨叫。
随即，万籁俱寂。
那诡异的麻痒与低语并未彻底消失，而是沉入了更深的地方，化作一整夜光怪陆离、支离破碎的噩梦。
天明时，他坐起，只觉气血凝实了许多。

唤出界面
《梅花拳·残》（粗通皮毛&nbp;909%）
熟练度涨了整整9%。
那梅花丹，果真邪门，也果真有用。
若能再得一颗，突破或许就在眼前。
他不禁开始盘算起下一次小试了。
清晨，路沉在街边摊坐下，要了碗豆浆，一碟煎包。
煎包咬下去，里边的馅儿是白菜帮子剁碎了混着点油渣，又糙又涩。
以前，这样的煎包他能一口气吞下三碟，还觉着是难得的美味。
如今跟着金铭下了几回馆子，肚子里装过几顿油水，嘴竟不知不觉被养刁了。
他没停，就着豆浆，一口一口，把整碟包子全咽了下去。
付了几文钱，他起身往武馆走。
content_en:
There is plenty of wine and food, and the cups and plates are in a mess.
Lu Shen returned to the small courtyard in Yangdung Alley.
At night, Lu Chen swallowed the plum blossom pill.
As the medicine dissipates, at first I feel a warm current rising from my belly and slowly spreading to my limbs.
He wrapped his quilt tightly and lay on the kang, closing his eyes and regulating his breath.
Not long after, the warmth suddenly stagnated, and then turned into bursts of strange itching, as if there were countless tiny insects crawling in the blood.
Cold sweat broke out on Lu Chen's forehead.
Just then, a murmur sounded in my ears.
What started as a vague murmur gradually became clearer.
But it was a thick and twisted whisper that he couldn't understand at all.
The voice got closer and closer, getting louder and louder, and finally it was close to his eardrums, squeezing out words he could understand word by word.
"Mother...mother..."
"Open my stomach...let me out..."
The shrill childish voice was full of tears, but every word was cold, as if they were crawling out of his own belly.
Lu Chen opened his eyes suddenly, grabbed the liquor from the kangtou, bit open the stopper and poured it down his throat.
The strong drink burned down his throat.
A sharp, inhuman scream suddenly came from his belly.
Immediately, everything fell silent.
The weird itching and whispering did not disappear completely, but sank deeper into the place, turning into a bizarre and fragmented nightmare all night long.
At dawn, he sat up and felt that his energy and blood had become much thicker.
Call up interface
"Plum Blossom Fist·Remnant" (rough knowledge&nbp;909%)
Proficiency increased by a full 9%.
That Plum Blossom Pill is really evil and really useful.
If we can get another one, a breakthrough may be just around the corner.
He couldn't help but start thinking about the next small test.
In the early morning, Lu Chen sat down at a street stall and ordered a bowl of soy milk and a plate of fried buns.
When you bite into the fried bun, you will find that the stuffing inside is chopped cabbage mixed with some oil residue, which is rough and astringent.
In the past, he could swallow three plates of fried buns like this in one sitting and still thought it was a rare delicacy.
Now I've been to restaurants with Jin Ming a few times, and I've had a lot of food in my stomach, but my mouth has been tricked without knowing it.
He didn't stop, just drank the soy milk, and swallowed the whole plate of steamed buns in one mouthful.
After paying a few pennies, he got up and walked to the martial arts studio.
